nom: Rael Miracle Clear Soothing Spot Gel

segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin report the gel is fragrance-free or nearly scentless and does not cause irritation, with one noting it replaced tea tree oil that had become too irritating.
segments.mature: One reviewer describes it as gentle and effective for mature or delicate skin, and another in her 40s reports it helped hormonal-IUD-triggered acne and improved overall skin quality.

concerns.spots: Most reviewers report individual pimples shrinking or disappearing within a day or two, often applied at the first sign of a spot; a few report no visible change after weeks of consistent use.
concerns.blemishes: Many describe blemishes clearing up quickly or becoming less noticeable, including cystic and hormonal breakouts; a couple say results were minor ('did not see a drastic change') though without added irritation.
concerns.redness: Numerous reviewers report reduced redness and calmer-looking skin around active spots, sometimes within hours; one reviewer explicitly says it made zero difference to redness.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer notes it did not disturb the skin barrier the way other acne treatments can.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer reports it helped with excess sebum build-up around active breakouts.

aspects.libelle: Dries clear and quickly on skin
Product runs out quickly for the price
No sting or tacky residue after use

extraits.texte: i dont have cystic acne or anything crazy, just the occasional pimples. this made absolutely zero difference in my skin and my breakouts. it didnt even decrease redness- nothing. i used jt for a month consistently. giving two stars beacause the applicator and push pen are a genius idea!

extraits.titre: Works good but application is annoying
extraits.texte: This works very well for helping to reduce inflammation, especially for a just-popped-pimple, and i would have given 5 stars... however, using the pen is obnoxious. You have to click the pen and it takes 1-2 min for ANY product to come out- and unless your just covering 1 tiny pimple, you have to repeat this process several times, totaling 4-6 mins to cover a few spots on your face. I dont always have that much time to sit around and wait like that therefore I dont reach for this as often as I would otherwise.
Perfect blemish zapper for delicate or mature skin! Very gentle, yet the zit disappears in a day or two. So glad I tried this product :-)

extraits.titre: Perfect for my extra sensitive skin.
extraits.texte: My skin never used to have too many issues, and if i had a spot appearing i would use something like tea tree oil. That recently became too sensitive for my skin, and this has saved my skin from getting too irritated and works wonders.
It shrinks my cystic hormonal pimples. It literally shrunk it over night and took most of the redness away

I love how sleek and easygoing the packaging is. I typically pack this in my on the go bag so I can apply this whenever I see the slightest spot pop up. The product is shaped like a marker so it fits easily anywhere. The product itself comes out clear so it is undetectable when applied which is why it is perfect for on the go. I also find that there's not really a scent to the product so it's perfect for me since I have sensitive skin. It's entertaining to click the top to dispense product so overall I love it and would repurchase.

I'm 42 and recently began using a hormonal IUD which caused acne like I was a teenager! Not cute! These products have saved my skin. Not only do they help clear the acne, but quality of my skin has drastically improved.
